QuestInfo.name: The Girl Who Lost Everything
QuestInfo.0: The 'ghost' you encountered was no spirit, but a #bGrim Reaper#k named Steve. He came to take the girl you've been hanging out with. According to him she's a ghost and doesn't even know it... How can you tell her when you can't even believe it yourself?
